sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Research Queries (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official directory identifies Flare/Vent Exceptions Statewide Rule 32 Query as a separately named oil-and-gas query, labels its update frequency as nightly, and publishes the agency data-set limitation.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves the official entry route, update context, and source limitation without treating a displayed result as authoritative, legally controlling, connected to private property, or sufficient for a downstream conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, About the Flare/Vent Exceptions SWR 32 Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official About page says the query searches Form R-32 applications submitted on or after May 2, 2021 and makes authorized exception information available through the query when an application has been approved.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses those statements only for source coverage and interface context, not as evidence that an exception applies to a reader, an event occurred, or a property or private interest is connected.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, SWR 32 Public Query (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official query screen supplies the named route and current source-displayed criteria, status, property, operator, location, date, search, and reset labels.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records only criteria and interface states actually used or observed and does not submit, reproduce, or interpret a property-specific result.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, SWR 32 Public Query User Guide (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official guide describes search criteria, all-criteria matching behavior, statuses, date and identifier formats, result-grid navigation, application details, and attachments.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article preserves source-displayed instructions and route states without deciding application meaning, regulatory effect, occurrence, compliance, environmental effect, or a private-property relationship.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Current Rules (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The RRC Current Rules page identifies the official rule location and supplies current chapter links and informational PDFs.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to keep rule-source context separate from query retrieval and makes no legal or compliance interpretation.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Chapter 3 Oil and Gas Division rules PDF effective 2025-12-08 (accessed 2026-08-24)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official informational Chapter 3 PDF identifies its effective date and includes Statewide Rule 32 in the Oil and Gas Division rules corpus.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article records the rule-source route and version only; it does not interpret the rule, decide whether an exception was required, or determine compliance.
